items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Rex was a great trumpet player.

ctx.x: I don't know. I suppose it was... It could have been Cincinnati. It could have been... I don't know. I really don't remember.
They had Rex in the band. No one ever says anything about Rex! I wonder why. Rex was a great trumpet player.
You know who talks about him always? Roy. Roy would always mention Rex. Even if he sometimes talks...sometimes talks about how he finally got to him. He says Rex upset him, you know, at first...
